```{r import data}
#####################################
# PREPARE THE DATA
#####################################

# Clear the console and load packages
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))
library(rmarkdown)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(cowplot)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(grid)

options(scipen = 999, digits=3)

# Load function to tidy up data frames from raw data
tidydata <- function(Data) {
  
  Experiment <- deparse(substitute(Data))
  
# Tidy up the columns and make sure the columns are coded correctly
Data$Group <- as.character(Data$Experiment) # Whether participants received direct instruction - converted to factor in next block of code
Data$TestingGroup <- as.factor(Data$TestingGroup) # When participants were tested
Data$Task <- as.character(Data$ExperimentName) # Experimental task - changed to factor later in code
Data$Script <- as.factor(Data$Language) # Georgian vs. Hungrarian script
Data$Subject <- as.factor(Data$Subject) # Participant

if (Experiment == "OPReadTest" | Experiment == "OSNameTest" | Experiment == "AudSem"){
Data$Phonology <- as.factor(Data$Aud) # Item pronunciation
Data$Semantics <- as.factor(Data$Sem) # Item meaning
}

Data$Orthography <- as.factor(Data$Vis) # Item written form
Data$Trial <- as.numeric(Data$Trial) # Trial number within the task
Data$SemanticMarker <- as.character(Data$Systematic) # Whether Semantic Marker systematically denoted the semantic category - - converted to factor in next block of code
Data$Acc <- as.integer(Data$Acc) # Accuracy: 1 = Correct, 0 = Incorrect

# Relabel task with clearer names
Data$Task <- gsub("_.*$", "", Data$Task)
Data$Task <- as.factor(Data$Task)
Data$Task <- gsub("OPRead", "Reading Aloud", Data$Task)
Data$Task <- gsub("OSName", "Saying the Meaning", Data$Task)
Data$Task <- gsub("AudSem", "Auditory-Semantic Matching", Data$Task)
Data$Task <- gsub("OldNew", "Recognition Memory", Data$Task)
Data$Task <- gsub("SemGen", "SemG_en", Data$Task) # Temporary name to avoid accidental conversion on next line
Data$Task <- gsub("Gen", "NonwordReadingAloud", Data$Task)
Data$Task <- gsub("SemG_en", "SemanticGeneralization", Data$Task)
Data$Task <- as.character(Data$Task)
Data$Task <- as.factor(Data$Task)

# Relabel group and systematicity factors with clearer names
Data$Group[Data$Group == "Exp2"] = "Discovery Learning"
Data$Group[Data$Group == "Exp3"] = "Explicit Learning"
Data$SemanticMarker[Data$SemanticMarker == "1"] = "Systematic"
Data$SemanticMarker[Data$SemanticMarker == "0"] = "Arbitrary"

Data$Group <- as.factor(Data$Group)
Data$SemanticMarker<- as.factor(Data$SemanticMarker)

# Remove outlier participant(s)
Data <- Data[Data$Subject != "317",] # Excluded due to poor performance in final day test task
Data <- Data[Data$Subject != "318",] # Excluded as did withdrew from experiment after Session 0
Data$Subject <- factor(Data$Subject)

# Return tidied data frame
Data <- Data

}

tag_facet2 <-  function(p, open="(", close = ")",
         tag_pool = letters,
         x = 0, y = 0.5,
         hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, 
         fontface = 2, ...){
  
  gb <- ggplot_build(p)
  lay <- gb$layout$layout
  nm <- names(gb$layout$facet$params$rows)
  
  tags <- paste0(open,tag_pool[unique(lay$COL)],close)
  
  tl <- lapply(tags, grid::textGrob, x=x, y=y,
               hjust=hjust, vjust=vjust, gp=grid::gpar(fontface=fontface))
  
  g <- ggplot_gtable(gb)
  g <- gtable::gtable_add_rows(g, grid::unit(1,"line"), pos = 0)
  lm <- unique(g$layout[grepl("panel",g$layout$name), "l"])
  g <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(g, grobs = tl, t=1, l=lm)
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(g)
}
```

**Plots**  

``` {r test plot 1}
# Plot showing accuracy performance in Reading Aloud, Say the Meaning, Non-Word Reading Aloud and Auditory-Semantic Matching test tasks

# Merge the tasks together into one data frame using common columns
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(OPReadTest), colnames(OSNameTest))
common_cols <- intersect(common_cols, colnames(AudSem))
Data <- rbind(OPReadTest[,common_cols], OSNameTest[,common_cols], AudSem[,common_cols])
Data <- tidydata(Data)

#####################################
# CREATE TABLES OF MEANS
#####################################

# Subject accuracy
SubjectAcc <- Data %>%
  group_by(Group, Task, Subject, SemanticMarker) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(subject_mean = mean(Acc), # Calculate subject mean accuracy
            std_dev = sd(Acc), # Calculate subject standard deviation
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows)) %>% # Calculate subject standard error
  dplyr::mutate(legend_label = paste0(Group, " ", SemanticMarker)) # Create a column with neat legend labels for plots

# Group accuracy - check if standard error should be for within subjects
GroupAcc <- SubjectAcc %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Group, Task, SemanticMarker, legend_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(group_mean = mean(subject_mean), # Calculate group mean accuracy
            std_dev = sd(subject_mean), # Calculate group standard deviation
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows)) # Calculate group standard error

# Tidy up the legend labels for plots
GroupAcc$legend_label <- gsub(" Learning ", " ", GroupAcc$legend_label)
GroupAcc$legend_label <- as.character(GroupAcc$legend_label)
GroupAcc$legend_label <- factor(GroupAcc$legend_label, levels=c("Explicit Systematic", "Explicit Arbitrary", "Discovery Systematic", "Discovery Arbitrary"))

SubjectAcc$legend_label <- gsub(" Learning ", " ", SubjectAcc$legend_label)
SubjectAcc$legend_label <- as.character(SubjectAcc$legend_label)
SubjectAcc$legend_label <- factor(SubjectAcc$legend_label, levels=c("Explicit Systematic", "Explicit Arbitrary", "Discovery Systematic", "Discovery Arbitrary"))

#####################################
# CREATE PLOTS
#####################################

# Use a template for the appearance of each plot
apatheme <- theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"),
        plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 10, margin = margin(b = 20)),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color='black'),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color='black'),
        axis.text.y=element_text(color = 'black'),
        axis.text.x=element_text(color = 'black'),
        strip.text.x = element_text(face="bold", size = 10, margin = margin(b = 10)),
        strip.background = element_blank())


# Format AudSem task name to fit on the graph
AudSem_wrapped <- str_wrap("Auditory-Semantic Matching", width = 17)
GroupAcc$Task <- gsub("Auditory-Semantic Matching", AudSem_wrapped, GroupAcc$Task)
SubjectAcc$Task <- gsub("Auditory-Semantic Matching", AudSem_wrapped, SubjectAcc$Task)

levels <- c("Reading Aloud", "Saying the Meaning", AudSem_wrapped)
SubjectAcc$Task <- as.character(SubjectAcc$Task)
SubjectAcc$Task <- factor(SubjectAcc$Task, levels = levels)
GroupAcc$Task <- as.character(GroupAcc$Task)
GroupAcc$Task <- factor(GroupAcc$Task, levels = levels)

# Add panel annotation labels
GroupAcc <- GroupAcc %>%
  mutate(annotation = case_when(Task == "Reading Aloud" ~ str_wrap("4A. Reading Aloud", width = 17),
                                Task == "Saying the Meaning" ~ str_wrap("4B. Saying the Meaning", width = 17),
                                Task == AudSem_wrapped ~ str_wrap("4C. Auditory-Semantic Matching", width = 17)))

# Add details for chance performance line
annotation <- str_wrap("4C. Auditory-Semantic Matching", width = 17)
Chance <- 0.25
chance_performance <- data.frame(annotation, Chance)
chance_performance$annotation <- as.factor(chance_performance$annotation)

# Plot mean group and subject accuracy performance in Reading Aloud, Saying the Meaning & Auditory Semantic Matching
test_plot_1 <- ggplot(GroupAcc, aes(x = legend_label, y = group_mean))+
  geom_hline(data = chance_performance, aes(yintercept = Chance), color = "black", linetype="dotted", alpha = 0.9)+
  geom_jitter(data = SubjectAcc, aes(x = legend_label, y = subject_mean), width = 0.05, shape = 21, alpha = 0.7, size = 1)+
  geom_tile(aes(height = (std_err * 2), colour = legend_label, fill = legend_label), alpha = 0.8, size=0.2, width=0.5)+
  geom_crossbar(aes(ymin= group_mean, ymax = group_mean, colour = legend_label), width = 0.6, size = 0.8)+
  xlab("")+ylab("Proportion Accuracy")+
  scale_x_discrete(label=function(x) abbreviate(x, minlength=2))+
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("#377EB8", "#377EB8", "#E41A1C", "#E41A1C"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#377EB8", "#AFCBE3", "#E41A1C", "#F4A3A4"))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1))+
  coord_cartesian(clip = 'off')+
  facet_wrap(.~annotation, strip.position="top", ncol=3, scale="free")+
  apatheme+
  guides(colour = FALSE)+
  theme(axis.line.x = element_line(color='black'),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color='black'),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"))

# Add axes labels to all graphs in the panel
g <- ggplotGrob(test_plot_1)
g$grobs$axis_b1$children[[2]][["grobs"]][[2]] <- nullGrob()
g$grobs$axis_b2$children[[2]][["grobs"]][[2]] <- nullGrob()
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(g)

print(test_plot_1)

```

``` {r test plot 2}
# Plot showing d' prime performance in Recognition Memory test task

# Tidy data
OldNew <- tidydata(OldNew)

# Relabel Condition with clearer names
OldNew$Condition <- as.character(OldNew$Phon.1.Sem.2.)
OldNew$Condition[OldNew$Condition == "0"] = "Target"
OldNew$Condition[OldNew$Condition == "1"] = "Phonological Distractors"
OldNew$Condition[OldNew$Condition == "2"] = "Semantic Distractors"
OldNew$Condition <- factor(OldNew$Condition, levels=c("Target", "Phonological Distractors", "Semantic Distractors"))

#####################################
# D PRIME
#####################################

### D prime scores for Hits & Phonological Distractors ###
OldNew_phonological <- OldNew[OldNew$Condition != "Semantic Distractors",] # Remove semantic distractors from OldNew

  # Code responses as hits, misses, correct rejections and false alarms
  dprime_phonological <- OldNew_phonological %>%
    mutate(Signal = case_when(Acc == 1 & Condition == "Target" ~ "Hit",
                              Acc == 0 & Condition == "Target" ~ "Miss",
                              Acc == 1 & Condition == "Phonological Distractors" ~ "CR",
                              Acc == 0 & Condition == "Phonological Distractors" ~ "FA",
                              Acc == 1 & Condition == "Semantic Distractors" ~ "CR",
                              Acc == 0 & Condition == "Semantic Distractors" ~ "FA"),
           Distractor = "5A. Phonological Distractors")
  dprime_phonological$Signal <- as.factor(dprime_phonological$Signal)
  
  # Calculate proportion of hits and false alarms for each subject
  dprime_phonological <- dprime_phonological %>%
    group_by(Group, SemanticMarker, Subject, Distractor) %>%
    summarise(n_hit = length(which(Signal == "Hit")),
              n_fa = length(which(Signal == "FA")),
              hit = n_hit / (n_hit + n_fa),
              fa = n_fa / (n_hit + n_fa))
  
  
  # Correct for ceiling effects
  Correction <- 1 - 1 / (2 * length(unique(dprime_phonological$Subject)))
  dprime_phonological$hit <- recode(dprime_phonological$hit, "1.00" = Correction)
  dprime_phonological$fa <- recode(dprime_phonological$fa, "0.00" = (1 - Correction))
  
  
  # Calculate d prime for each subject
  dprime_phonological$dprime <- qnorm(dprime_phonological$hit) - qnorm(dprime_phonological$fa)

  
  
### D prime scores for Hits & Semantic Distractors ###
OldNew_semantic <- OldNew[OldNew$Condition != "Phonological Distractors",] # Remove phonological distractors from OldNewset

  # Code responses as hits, misses, correct rejections and false alarms
  dprime_semantic <- OldNew_semantic %>%
    mutate(Signal = case_when(Acc == 1 & Condition == "Target" ~ "Hit",
                              Acc == 0 & Condition == "Target" ~ "Miss",
                              Acc == 1 & Condition == "Phonological Distractors" ~ "CR",
                              Acc == 0 & Condition == "Phonological Distractors" ~ "FA",
                              Acc == 1 & Condition == "Semantic Distractors" ~ "CR",
                              Acc == 0 & Condition == "Semantic Distractors" ~ "FA"),
           Distractor = "5B. Semantic Distractors")
  dprime_semantic$Signal <- as.factor(dprime_semantic$Signal)
  
  # Calculate proportion of hits and false alarms for each subject
  dprime_semantic <- dprime_semantic %>%
    group_by(Group, SemanticMarker, Subject, Distractor) %>%
    summarise(n_hit = length(which(Signal == "Hit")),
              n_fa = length(which(Signal == "FA")),
              hit = n_hit / (n_hit + n_fa),
              fa = n_fa / (n_hit + n_fa))
  
  
  # Correct for ceiling effects
  Correction <- 1 - 1 / (2 * length(unique(dprime_semantic$Subject)))
  dprime_semantic$hit <- recode(dprime_semantic$hit, "1.00" = Correction)
  dprime_semantic$fa <- recode(dprime_semantic$fa, "0.00" = (1 - Correction))
  
  
  # Calculate d prime for each subject
  dprime_semantic$dprime <- qnorm(dprime_semantic$hit) - qnorm(dprime_semantic$fa)

  # Combine d'prime data for plots
dprime_both <- rbind(dprime_phonological, dprime_semantic)

# Calculate group-level statistics
dprime_group <- dprime_both %>%
  group_by(Group, SemanticMarker, Distractor) %>%
  summarise(group_mean = mean(dprime),
            std_dev = sd(dprime),
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows))


#####################################
# CREATE PLOTS
#####################################

# Combine d'prime data for plots
dprime_both <- rbind(dprime_phonological, dprime_semantic)
dprime_both <- dprime_both %>%
               mutate(legend_label = paste0(Group, " ", SemanticMarker)) 

dprime_group <- dprime_both %>%
  group_by(Group, SemanticMarker, Distractor) %>%
  summarise(group_mean = mean(dprime),
            std_dev = sd(dprime),
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows)) %>%
  mutate(legend_label = paste0(Group, " ", SemanticMarker))

# Tidy up the legend labels
dprime_both$legend_label <- gsub(" Learning ", " ", dprime_both$legend_label)
dprime_group$legend_label <- gsub(" Learning ", " ", dprime_group$legend_label)

dprime_both$legend_label <- as.character(dprime_both$legend_label)
dprime_both$legend_label <- factor(dprime_both$legend_label, levels=c("Explicit Systematic", "Explicit Arbitrary", "Discovery Systematic", "Discovery Arbitrary"))

dprime_group$legend_label <- as.character(dprime_group$legend_label)
dprime_group$legend_label <- factor(dprime_group$legend_label, levels=c("Explicit Systematic", "Explicit Arbitrary", "Discovery Systematic", "Discovery Arbitrary"))

# Create d prime plot of subject and group level data  
test_plot_2 <- ggplot(dprime_group, aes(x = legend_label, y = group_mean, group = legend_label))+
  geom_jitter(data = dprime_both, aes(x = legend_label, y = dprime, group = legend_label), width = 0.05, shape = 21, alpha = 0.7, size = 1)+
  geom_tile(aes(height = (std_err * 2), colour = legend_label, fill = legend_label, group = legend_label), size=0.2, width=0.5, alpha = 0.8, position=position_dodge(0.65))+
  geom_crossbar(aes(ymin= group_mean, ymax = group_mean, colour = legend_label, group = legend_label), width = 0.6, position=position_dodge(0.65), size = 0.8)+
  xlab("")+ylab("d prime")+
  scale_x_discrete(label=function(x) abbreviate(x, minlength=2))+
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("#377EB8", "#377EB8", "#E41A1C", "#E41A1C"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#377EB8", "#AFCBE3", "#E41A1C", "#F4A3A4"))+
  #scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Group")+
  #scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Group")+
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.4, 0.8), name = "Semantic Marker") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,5))+
  coord_cartesian(clip = 'off')+
  facet_wrap(.~Distractor, strip.position="top", scale="free")+
  guides(colour = FALSE)+
  apatheme+
  theme(axis.line.x = element_line(color='black'),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color='black'),
        strip.placement = "outside")

# Add axes labels to all graphs in the panel
g <- ggplotGrob(test_plot_2)
g$grobs$axis_b1$children[[2]][["grobs"]][[2]] <- nullGrob()
g$grobs$axis_b2$children[[2]][["grobs"]][[2]] <- nullGrob()
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(g)

print(test_plot_2)
```

``` {r test plot 3}
# Plot showing accuracy performance in Read Aloud Nonwords and Semantic Generalization test tasks

# Remove results from arbitrary language for SemGen (as no correct answer)
SemGen <- tidydata(SemGen)
SemGen <- SemGen[SemGen$SemanticMarker == "Systematic",]

# Merge the tasks together into one data frame using common columns
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(Gen), colnames(SemGen))
Data <- rbind(Gen[,common_cols], SemGen[,common_cols])
Data <- tidydata(Data)

#####################################
# CREATE TABLES OF MEANS
#####################################

# Subject accuracy
SubjectAcc <- Data %>%
  group_by(Group, Task, Subject) %>%
  summarise(subject_mean = mean(Acc))

SubjectAcc_long <- SubjectAcc
SubjectAcc <- spread(SubjectAcc, key = Task, value = subject_mean)

# Group accuracy
GroupAcc <- SubjectAcc_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Group,Task) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(group_mean = mean(subject_mean),
            std_dev = sd(subject_mean),
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows))

GroupAcc_Gen <- GroupAcc %>% filter(Task == "NonwordReadingAloud")
GroupAcc_SemGen <- GroupAcc %>% filter(Task == "SemanticGeneralization")

# Summary of 75 percent or above to inform infographic
SubjectAcc75 <- na.omit(SubjectAcc) %>%
  mutate(spellingsound = case_when(NonwordReadingAloud >= 0.75 ~ 1,
                                   NonwordReadingAloud < 0.75 ~ 0),
         spellingmeaning = case_when(SemanticGeneralization >= 0.75 ~ 1,
                                     SemanticGeneralization < 0.75 ~ 0),
         both = case_when(spellingsound + spellingmeaning == 2 ~ 1,
                          spellingsound + spellingmeaning < 2 ~ 0)) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(spellingsound=n()-sum(spellingsound),
              spellingmeaning=n()-sum(spellingmeaning),
              both=n()-sum(both))


#####################################
# CREATE PLOT
#####################################

wrapped_label <- str_wrap("Mean Performance", width = 10)

test_plot_3 <- ggplot(SubjectAcc, aes(y = SemanticGeneralization, x = NonwordReadingAloud))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.6)+
  geom_jitter(data = SubjectAcc, aes(fill = Group), size = 3, shape = 21, alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_tile(data = GroupAcc_SemGen, aes(y = group_mean, x = -0.2, height = (std_err * 2), colour = Group, fill = Group, group = Group), size=0.2, width=0.15, position=position_dodge(0), alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_crossbar(data = GroupAcc_SemGen, aes(x = -0.2, y=group_mean, ymin = group_mean, ymax = group_mean, colour = Group, group = Group), width = 0.1, size = 0.75)+
  geom_tile(data = GroupAcc_Gen, aes(x = group_mean, y = -0.2, width = (std_err * 2), height = 0.085, colour = Group, fill = Group, group = Group), size=0.2, position=position_dodge(0), alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_linerange(data=GroupAcc_Gen, aes(x = group_mean, y = -0.2, group = Group, colour = Group), ymin = -0.26, ymax = -0.14, size = 1.5)+
  geom_text(aes(label = wrapped_label, x = -0.2, y = -0.2), size = 3)+
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", guide = FALSE)+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.25, 1.25), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0))+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.25, 1.25), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0))+
  xlab("Nonword Reading Aloud")+ylab("Semantic Generalization")+
  apatheme+
  theme(plot.margin = margin(),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color='black'),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color='black'))+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.25, 1), ylim = c(-0.25,1), clip = 'off')
print(test_plot_3)
```

<br>
*Paired t-tests*
``` {r read aloud t tests}

# Get subject-level data
SubjectAcc <- Data %>%
  group_by(Group, Subject, SemanticMarker) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(subject_mean = mean(Acc),
            std_dev = sd(Acc),
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows))

# Run t-tests to pick apart main effects of semantic marker
Discovery <- SubjectAcc[SubjectAcc$Group == "Discovery Learning",2:4]
Discovery <- spread(Discovery, key = SemanticMarker, value = subject_mean)

Explicit <- SubjectAcc[SubjectAcc$Group == "Explicit Learning",2:4]
Explicit <- spread(Explicit, key = SemanticMarker, value = subject_mean)

Discovery_ttest <- t.test(Discovery$Arbitrary, Discovery$Systematic, paired = TRUE)
print(format(round(Discovery_ttest$statistic, 2), nsmall = 2))
Explicit_ttest <- t.test(Explicit$Arbitrary, Explicit$Systematic, paired = TRUE)
print(format(round(Explicit_ttest$statistic, 2), nsmall = 2))
```
``` {r read aloud t tests output, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE}
Discovery_ttest
print(format(round(Discovery_ttest$statistic, 2), nsmall = 2))
print(format(round(Discovery_ttest$p.value, 3), nsmall = 3))
Explicit_ttest 
print(format(round(Explicit_ttest$statistic, 2), nsmall = 2))
print(format(round(Explicit_ttest$p.value, 3), nsmall = 3))
```
